import json, random, subprocess, sys, io
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
gen2 = importlib_imp = None
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("gen2","/workspace/tmp/gen2.py")
gen2 = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(gen2)

def run_bytes(data):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","submission/main.py"], input=data, capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr

GOOD = {"version":1,"n":4,"capacity":[2,2,1,3],
        "edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":2,"label":"a"},
                 {"u":0,"v":2,"ping_us":3,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
                 {"u":1,"v":3,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"b"},
                 {"u":2,"v":3,"ping_us":2,"ack_us":1,"label":"b"}],
        "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":9,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,
                   "drop_ping":[1],"drop_ack":[2]},
                  {"launch_us":4,"timeout_us":3,"host_delay_us":2,"drop_host_ack":True,
                   "drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]}

fails = 0
cases = 0
def check(name, data, expect=None):
    global fails, cases
    cases += 1
    rc, out, err = run_bytes(data)
    ok = True
    if rc not in (0,2):
        ok = False
    else:
        try:
            v = json.loads(out.decode('utf-8', 'strict'))
        except Exception:
            ok = False; v = None
        if ok and rc == 2 and v != {"error":"invalid-input"}:
            ok = False
        if ok and rc == 0 and (not isinstance(v,dict) or set(v) != {"rounds","metrics","classes","summary"}):
            ok = False
        if ok and expect is not None and v != expect:
            ok = False
    if not ok:
        fails += 1
        print("FAIL", name, "rc", rc, "out", out[:120], "err", err.decode()[-300:])
        if fails > 6: raise SystemExit(1)

# structural mutations of a valid document
rng = random.Random(11)
base_txt = json.dumps(GOOD)
check("baseline", base_txt.encode(), None)

for i in range(400):
    s = list(base_txt)
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1,3)):
        op = rng.random()
        pos = rng.randrange(len(s))
        if op < 0.4:
            s[pos] = rng.choice('{}[]",:0123456789.eEtfnsul-+ \\/*\n\t')
        elif op < 0.7:
            del s[pos]
        else:
            s.insert(pos, rng.choice('{}[]",:0123456789.eE-+\\ \t\n'))
    check("mut-%d"%i, "".join(s).encode())

# truncations
for i in range(1, len(base_txt), 7):
    check("trunc-%d"%i, base_txt[:i].encode())

# random byte flips on raw bytes
b = base_txt.encode()
for i in range(200):
    t = bytearray(b)
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1,4)):
        pos = rng.randrange(len(t))
        t[pos] = rng.randrange(256)
    check("byteflip-%d"%i, bytes(t))

# deep nesting
check("deep-array", (b'{"version":1,"n":2,"capacity":[1,1],"edges":[],"rounds":[],"x":' + b'['*5000 + b']'*5000 + b'}'), True)
check("deep-object", (b'{"version":1,"n":2,"capacity":[1,1],"edges":[],"rounds":[],"x":' + b'{"a":'*3000 + b'1' + b'}'*3000 + b'}'), True)
check("bignum", ('{"version":1,"n":2,"capacity":[1,1],"edges":[],"rounds":[],"x":' + '9'*5000 + '}').encode(), True)
check("huge-int-field", ('{"version":1,"n":2,"capacity":[1,1],"edges":[],"rounds":[{"launch_us":' + '9'*5000 + ',"timeout_us":1,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":false,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]}').encode(), True)
print("cases", cases, "fails", fails)
PYEOF
